breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (∂u/∂n = 0) and Dirichlet (u = 0) were specified for all boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Neumann condition. The agent correctly identified and fixed this issue by only specifying 'Neumann boundary conditions ∂u/∂n = 0 on all four boundary edges', thus matching the ground truth.
